reason: My team barely updates a spreadsheet at the end of the day, and they already know Bitrix24 even if it is heavy. I am not going to push them onto another tool and pay 199 dollars a month for it, since with 7 to 15 people I would need the Business plan.
objection: My team will not learn another tool, and moving all my clients over by hand is a lot of work for me. 199 dollars a month is a big chunk when I earn about 26k a year.
would_change_my_mind: Free import of my Bitrix24 and spreadsheet data, a trial where my team actually uses it for two weeks, and a price under about 100 dollars for my whole team.
